title: Fundamental Limits of Transferability and Equivariance in Algebraic Signal Models I: Finite Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2609.36106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the fundamental limits of transferability in algebraic signal processing through homomorphisms between algebraic signal models. Homomorphisms are linear maps between the signal spaces of two models that commute with filtering, so filtering a signal and transferring it across domains can be done in either order. The existence of such maps is governed entirely by coincidences among the filtered eigenvalues of the two models' shift operators, but existence alone is insufficient: the space of homomorphisms always contains trivial elements that destroy all information. We introduce the spectral transfer efficiency $\eta(\theta)\in[0,1]$ to quantify information-preserving quality, prove that every homomorphism decomposes into unconstrained blocks over coincidence classes, derive the dimension of the homomorphism space, and characterize exactly when lossless transfer is achievable. translated_title: 代数信号模型中可迁移性与等变性的基本极限（一）：有限维情形
translated_abstract: 我们通过代数信号模型之间的同态映射，研究代数信号处理中可迁移性的基本极限。同态是两个模型信号空间之间与滤波运算可交换的线性映射，因此对信号进行滤波与跨域迁移可以按任意顺序执行。这类映射的存在性完全由两个模型移位算子的滤波特征值之间的重合关系所决定，但仅存在性并不足够：同态空间中总是包含会破坏全部信息的平凡元素。我们引入谱迁移效率 η(θ)∈[0,1] 来量化信息保持的质量，证明每个同态都可分解为重合类上的无约束块，推导出同态空间的维数，并精确刻画了何时能够实现无损迁移。除正规移位算子外，我们还量化了偏离该情形时的变化（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过同态映射和谱迁移效率指标，基于特征值重合关系精确刻画了代数信号模型间信息保持迁移的存在条件与无损迁移的判据。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the fundamental limits of transferability between algebraic signal models via homomorphisms and a spectral transfer efficiency metric, precisely determining when information-preserving and lossless transfer is achievable based on eigenvalue coincidences.
